entry.title: Datum Dahleez CHAMPAGNE CARBON EB03
entry.summary:
Vendor: Datum Dahleez Store
Type: Home Decor
Price: 320.00

The EB03 cuvée is a 2013 vintage, which has initial scents of citrus, followed by aromas of spring flowers, then a growing intensity toward yellow citrus, toasty notes and aromatic herbs. On the palate it provides an initial intensity, followed by a creamier more velvety texture. The finish reveals hints of acidity. The grape variety is 100% Chardonnay Grand Cru, which will enhance a delicate recipe such as a scallop ceviche, a red tuna sashimi or a filet of Saint-Pierre with citrus fruits. The 750ml bottle is wrapped with Carbon Fiber. Packaging includes luxury box and free delivery all over Europe.

The EB02 cuvée is a vintage blanc de blancs 2006 boasts robe and fine bubbles, before opening-up to a large aromatic pallet with acacia notes, hazelnuts and stone fruits. The grape variety is 100% Chardonnay Grand Cru, which can be tasted both for aperitive, during a gastronomic meal or a happy moment of life, with raw ham of Pata Negra or a delicious caviar, this cuvée pairs well with all occasions. The 750ml bottle is wrapped with Carbon Fiber. Packaging includes luxury box and free delivery all over Europe.

entry.title: Datum Dahleez CHAMPAGNE CARBON EB01
entry.summary:
Vendor: Datum Dahleez Store
Type: Home Decor
Price: 320.00

The EB01 champagne is a vintage 2002 champagne created from 90% Chardonnay and 10% Pinot Noir. Blossoming floral aromas in the glass and everlasting smoothness and roundness on your pallet. A full-bodied vintage with crispy essences waltzes with lace-like bubbles in infinite whirls. The champagne unfolds a horizon of delightful green fruits and nuts, amplified by a jolting note of salty-minerality. The 750ml bottle is wrapped with Carbon Fiber. Packaging includes luxury box and free delivery all over Europe.
